name: QR & Barcode Generator
description: Generate QR codes and 1D barcodes (Code128, Code39, EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A, I2of5) from any data — URLs, product IDs, record links, free text. Accepts single items or lists; outputs a labelled PNG grid sheet, optional individual PNGs, and optional CSV. Fully offline — no extra dependencies beyond reportlab + Pillow.
author: Nazish Qasim
